editorial:
Imagine living on a remote farm where the wind never stops and the work never ends. You meet a father who is completely broken by his hard life, but he is obsessed with one thing: making sure his son takes over the family land. It starts off as a slow story about family duty, but you quickly realize something is very wrong. The father isn't just strict; he is starting to lose his grip on reality. You feel the tension build as the mother tries to play peacemaker, while the son realizes his dad is becoming dangerous. It is a heavy, moody ride that makes you feel trapped right along with the characters.

The acting is what really sells this movie because the lead actor makes you feel genuinely uneasy. While the story moves a bit slow at the start, the payoff is worth it because the scary moments hit hard. If you like stories about families falling apart in creepy ways, you will love this. For the best experience, you should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the gritty details of the farm. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great call.
endingExplained: The movie ends with the father completely losing his mind. He tries to force his son into the family legacy through violence and fear. In the final scenes, the tension snaps, and the son has to fight back to survive his father's madness. The cycle of pain on the farm finally breaks, but it happens in a tragic way that leaves the family destroyed. It shows that some legacies are better left behind than carried on.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological thrillers and gritty family dramas.
